method: human/LLM independent reading of extracted text (pdftotext), prior to running Themis
notes: Clause types use the 15-type extract taxonomy for comparability with Themis. Risk flags are my own judgment of deal risk, not Themis output.

lease_01_office_meridian.title: Office Lease (Oakmont Realty / Cobalt Industries), Austin TX, 10-yr term
risk_flags: 5.2: assignment on merger/sale of substantially all assets allowed WITHOUT landlord consent (tenant-friendly; loss of landlord control over change of control)
5.3: 25% sublease without consent (tenant-friendly)
6.2: landlord may terminate if casualty >50% of replacement cost (landlord-friendly)
7.1: no offset/counterclaim except as permitted (landlord-friendly)
7.2: landlord no duty to mitigate beyond law (landlord-friendly)

lease_02_retail_sundial.title: Retail Lease (Sundial Business Park / Brightwell Logistics), 7-yr term
risk_flags: Sec2: GO-DARK clause — tenant has NO obligation to operate, may cease business after year 3, landlord has no remedy/termination for cessation (significant landlord red flag)
Sec4: assignment to affiliate/controlled entity without landlord consent (tenant-friendly)
Sec3: extension at fair market rent via arbitration if not agreed (neutral)

lease_03_industrial_ferrous.title: Industrial Lease (Ferrous Manufacturing / Northgate Ventures), 8-yr term
risk_flags: 2.2/2.3: GUARANTY auto-transferable to assignee/successor without new guaranty instrument (guarantee-transferable red flag)
3.1: holdover at 150% of Base Rent
6.1: change of control (>50% voting) deemed assignment requiring consent
7.1: landlord may reinstate lease at sole discretion after cure (landlord-friendly)

lease_04_mixeduse_silverline.title: Mixed-Use Lease (Silverline Capital / Aurelia Systems), Chicago IL
risk_flags: 1.3: $62,000 security deposit by wire at execution (cash-flow burden)
5.2: landlord may TERMINATE on change of control if tenant operated by a competing business (landlord-friendly)
7.1: jury trial waiver (tenant-friendly to landlord)
7.2: landlord no liability for tenant property theft/vandalism

lease_05_smallsuite_thornfield.title: Small Suite Lease (Thornfield Group / Ridgeline Holdings), 60-month term
risk_flags: Break option: one-time termination at end of month 36 with 180 days notice + 3 months rent fee
NO OBLIGATION TO OPERATE — tenant may cease operations without breach (landlord red flag)
Sublease cap: cannot sublease at a rate higher than tenant's rent without consent
Landlord may waive late fee at sole discretion (tenant-friendly)

lease_06_table_rentschedule_bellwood.title: Lease with Rent Schedule (Bellwood Enterprises / Meridian Retail), 7-yr term
risk_flags: 4.1: late fee 5% of installment if not received within 5 days of due date
5.2: guarantor is a wholly owned subsidiary of tenant's parent (weak guaranty — parent not directly liable)
3.3: tenant audit right (tenant-friendly)

lease_07_edgecase_stresstest_windmere.title: Edge-case stress test lease (Windmere Capital / Halcyon Foods), 7-yr term
risk_flags: Stress test doc: compound/negated deontic language — expects model to handle nen (negated entitlements) correctly
1.1: no abatement right except Art6, despite quiet enjoyment (landlord-friendly)
1.3: waiver of rent offset regardless of merits
4.3: replacement guaranty/deposit increase triggered by guarantor net worth <$5M
